watch.summary: A creator reacts with hysterical laughter to a video of synchronized cheerleader robots malfunctioning and crashing face-first into the floor.

beats.what: Creator introduces the video of cheerleader robots.
The robots perform a routine and instantly faceplant onto the floor.
Creator bursts into wheezing laughter as the robots lie motionless.
Slow-motion replay shows all the robots jumping in sync and crashing down together.
Creator realizes multiple robots are failing, including one still rogue-dancing.
Creator holds his head in disbelief, dying of laughter.

watch.author: none
watch.why: The visual slapstick of expensive robots failing in unison is inherently funny. The creator's genuine wheezing laughter and observational commentary make the clip even more infectious.
